summary: The recorded base reproduced the dispatch defects with controlled fused-kernel spies, and the exact candidate passed its regression plus independent GPU-backed shape/layout boundary cases. No source counterexample was found. However, the assigned ROCm gfx950-class host cannot import or execute the affected CUDA-only Gemma kernel, so the original NVIDIA NaN behavior and actual fused CUDA execution remain unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before result: 4 failures and 1 pass. Rank-3 skipped the fused call; mixed-dtype normal and residual paths entered fused calls; invalid hidden width reached the mocked kernel.
Candidate regression: 5 tests passed for high-rank flatten/restore, noncontiguous input, mixed-dtype fallback with and without residual, and wrong hidden width.

tests.command: Independent GPU adversarial script using kernel spies and forward_native reference
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X, rank-1/3/4 and zero-sized rank-3/4 inputs dispatched once, restored shape, and exactly matched the native reference. Device mismatch avoided the fused call and raised from native tensor incompatibility.
Existing ROCm/native Gemma3RMSNorm coverage: 5 tests and 70 subtests passed on the assigned AMD GPU.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X executed independent tensor/reference checks and the existing ROCm/native suite; raw logs are under reports/j-8376c16c2c26/raw. This was not execution of the CUDA-only fused kernel.

remaining_counterexamples: No executable CUDA/NVIDIA environment was available to reproduce the original mixed-dtype NaN or prove that the fallback prevents it around the real gemma_rmsnorm and gemma_fused_add_rmsnorm binaries.
Real fused CUDA output for flattened rank-3 q_norm/k_norm inputs was not compared against an independent numerical reference.
The reported H200 performance gains and full Gemma-3 model behavior were not reproduced; no model weights or NVIDIA GPU were available.
remaining_limitations: The prepared host reports AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015, whereas the issue targets CUDA/H200.
sglang and layernorm.py imported from /job/repo/python; sgl_kernel imported from the prepared installed ROCm environment under /opt/venv.
The candidate changes only Python and adds tests/reports, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
No full-model, serving-path, semantic-accuracy, throughput, or multi-node claim is made.
